label: reverse-resource-answer-kind
expected_literal: wrong read kind refuses without consuming waiter
scope_note: Kind check is independently reachable with a live snapshot waiter and events routing header.

label: reverse-resource-query-bytes
scope_note: The first invalid query is 1025 bytes and remains semantically valid. Shared Kind::labels is used by hub and leaf.

label: reverse-resource-answer-declared-length
expected_literal: declared oversize refuses before invoking body reader
scope_note: The independent read-attempt assertion discriminates this declared-length gate from the streaming and DTO decoder gates.

label: reverse-resource-answer-stream-limit
expected_literal: streaming reader never buffers an oversized answer even if semantic decoder refuses it
scope_note: Allocation high-water assertion detects this fault even though semantic DTO validation still refuses the over-limit body.

label: reverse-resource-control-declared-length
expected_literal: declared control oversize never invokes body reader
scope_note: Read-attempt assertion detects the missing declared gate independently of the Limited reader.

label: reverse-resource-control-stream-limit
expected_literal: raw control read never collects over8KiB before semantic validation
scope_note: Only the raw streaming cap is widened; the independent semantic body_bytes length check remains and the buffering assertion discriminates it.

label: reverse-resource-forward-deadline
expected_literal: expired prepared response is unreachable, never empty success

label: reverse-resource-answer-final-deadline
expected_literal: completed late stream is refused at the answer hop
scope_note: Clock advances after the first chunk; initial answer admission is still timely. Final collector deadline remains but answer-hop status independently detects this fault.

label: reverse-resource-answer-read-deadline
expected_literal: stalled answer did not terminate at its original five-second deadline while producer stayed open
scope_note: The discriminating assertion explicitly observes a still-open producer at the original deadline; this is an assertion failure, not harness timeout.

label: reverse-resource-answer-stream-reservation-lifetime
expected_literal: cancelled collector cannot release resources still owned by its live answer read
scope_note: Only the answer stream ownership clone is removed; after collector cancellation the stream must still own the original permits.

label: reverse-resource-pair-forward-lifetime
expected_literal: same pair stays reserved while a completed DTO awaits forwarding
scope_note: Releases only the pair reservation after the answer is ready, before final forwarding; slot and buffer reservations remain.

label: reverse-resource-post-connection-lane
expected_literal: all eight admitted answers queue behind exactly one observed POST connection
scope_note: All eight valid projected answers reach post_answer; observed connection peak independently distinguishes one from two simultaneous POSTs.

label: reverse-resource-refusal-lane-across-restart
expected_literal: worker restart cannot create a ninth refusal task before the original eight finish
scope_note: Original eight refusal tasks remain stalled across worker restart. Ninth dispatch must not spawn a new refusal task.

label: reverse-resource-control-class-fairness
expected_literal: all existing control classes progress within three dispatches despite observe backlog
scope_note: Three Observe items stay queued; a nonrotating scheduler dispatches all three before existing Attachment and List work.

label: reverse-resource-bound-query
expected_literal: each actual collector retains its bound query and route
scope_note: Three authenticated collectors use distinct limits; actual control envelope must retain each original collector query.

label: reverse-resource-fresh-id-after-restart
expected_literal: fresh waiter gets a fresh opaque id
scope_note: Fresh waiter after cancelled old worker request must use a distinct opaque id; constant id makes replay possible without modifying test fixtures.

label: reverse-resource-answer-live-id
scope_note: Both accesses implement the same live request-id binding. Fault chooses an arbitrary live waiter for both answer admission and consumption, so unknown id is independently refused only by the original lookups.

label: reverse-resource-answer-leaf-binding
expected_literal: authenticated wrong leaf refuses without consuming live waiter
scope_note: Node name and full authenticated identity are duplicated representations of the same expected answer leaf binding. Both are removed together; stored collector/route authorization remains unchanged. This does not independently claim coverage for each representation.
